title: The Spirit and the Church
definition: The Spirit and the Church refers to the Holy Spirit's work of forming, indwelling, gifting, uniting, and sending the body of Christ.
summary: The Church lives by the presence and power of the Holy Spirit.
christFocus: Jesus builds His Church and gives the Spirit to dwell in, unite, and empower His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Church is not merely a human institution. It is the body of Christ indwelt and empowered by the Holy Spirit.

The Spirit forms the Church, unites believers, distributes gifts, empowers witness, guides mission, and makes the Church a dwelling place for God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches often rely on programs, personality, or tradition while neglecting dependence on the Spirit. This doctrine matters because the Church needs the Spirit for life and mission.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for the Spirit's work in your church. Pursue unity, holiness, Word-centered worship, spiritual gifts used in love, and Gospel mission.

relatedTopics: Spiritual Gifts and Ministry of the Holy Spirit
